etymologies.etymologyHTML: From pessimist +‎ -ic.

definitions.definition: Marked by pessimism and little hopefulness; expecting the worst.

quote.citation: 1996, George Thomas Kurian, Graham Thomas Tate Molitor, Encyclopedia of the future, volume 1, page 212:
quote.text: However pessimistic their predictions, most scientists and scholars who warn of impending disaster are really acting from antidystopian motives.

definitions.definition: (computing) Taking out exclusive locks on data to prevent conflicts with other processes that might modify it.
